winner.title: Rwandan "Agatogo" with Collard Greens

evidence.authenticity: Plantains, tomato paste, onion, garlic, greens, ground peanuts, lots of salt per locals. Author explains the dish always has plantains, tomato and meat/fish/veg, and that meat is scarce and smoked fish (injanga) is for people on the water. Author is not Rwandan, and no culinary credentials are listed.
evidence.precision: Only 1 of 9 ingredients has a weight (6 oz tomato paste). Others are 'large onion', '4 plantains (mostly green)', '1 quart broth'. No pan size or temperatures. Cues: onions soft, just beginning to color, plantains tender and no longer white, thin with broth to taste.
evidence.testing: Gives a peel technique for green plantains (chunk, slit once, crack back, paring knife if needed), the reason for heavy salt (plantains absorb it), and how to adjust thickness. No formal test-kitchen process described.
evidence.photos: WebFetch showed five step photos in the Method (peeling, onion and garlic frying, simmering, thinning, serving). Schema stepImages is 0.
evidence.efficiency: Simple one-pot, 30 min simmer. No total time stated, and the peeling time is not given.
evidence.access: Plantains, collards, tomato paste and peanuts are all at US grocers. No subs listed but none are needed.

winner.why: It is the only candidate that is traditional (plantain-based), has real step photos and explains the peeling and salting, though it falls just short of 60 on precision.

runnerUp.title: Agatogo

evidence.authenticity: Vegan plantain stew, but adds carrots, bell pepper, Bragg's aminos, onion/garlic powder and bouillon cubes. These are modern pantry shortcuts, and there is no regional context.
evidence.precision: Medium-sized produce and 2 inch plantain pieces, 0 ingredient weights, 3 cups water, 1 pan mention. Cues: onion soft, tomatoes soft, plantains tender after about 20 min.
evidence.testing: Rated 5 from only 2 ratings. No reasoning given.
evidence.photos: No step images in the schema. About 30 images on the page, unconfirmed as process photos.

runnerUp.why: It is more precise on sizing but is a Westernized vegan version with no context or process photos.

candidates.disqualified: Generic mixed-vegetable stew with no plantains, no amounts for several ingredients, no author, and one photo. Not recognizably the plantain-based agatogo.
Page loads (200) but WebFetch returned the site homepage with no recipe content, so it could not be scored. Likely a re-post of the Global Table Adventure recipe.
